posts.text: Safety and liberty are not a choice. My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act proves you can have both, without giving unelected agencies a blank check to spy on Americans.

We can fight terrorism without giving up our rights. Use 702 for foreign intelligence, but don’t search Americans without a warrant. Security and liberty aren’t mutually exclusive. @edhenry

Video

Good intentions don't balance a checkbook. We passed a budget. Then ignored it. We spend $7T and bring in $5T. Until that changes, every budget document in Washington isn't worth the ink it's printed with. @VarneyCo

Video

I just introduced bipartisan legislation to regulate hemp products and protect consumers. Washington has let this industry operate in a gray zone for too long. Americans deserve clarity about what they're buying. This is commonsense policy that crosses party lines. washingtonexaminer.com/news/…
Protect the privacy of American citizens. Reform FISA.

The Fourth Amendment is not optional. My Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act bans warrantless surveillance of Americans, shuts down backdoor data searches, and limits secret courts to foreign targets only.

Washington doesn't have a revenue problem. It has a spending problem. My Six Penny Plan fixes it: cut 6 cents from every dollar spent for 5 years. Families balance their budgets. Washington should, too.

Video

And I’m one of them - are you?

It’s time to end warrantless spying on Americans.


Rep. Keith Self (@RepKeithSelf)

76% of Americans support requiring the government to get a warrant before searching international communications for Americans’ information.

No more warrantless spying on Americans. It’s time to fix FISA.





— https://nitter.net/RepKeithSelf/status/2046576146578313415#m

We shouldn’t be spying on Americans without a warrant. It’s that simple.

FISA was meant for foreign intelligence, not sweeping up your calls and texts just because you talked to someone who talked to someone overseas.

I’m putting forth an amendment that would make the government obtain a warrant if it wants to look at Americans and use it to stop terrorism. @MariaBartiromo

Video

The national debt crossed $39 trillion for the first time last month. That's another trillion added in five months. Interest alone is running $88 billion a month. Cut six cents out of every projected dollar for five years and the budget balances. It isn't radical. It's basic math.

I continue to believe that President Trump was abused by US govt. intel agencies.  I continue to believe that 702 info vacuumed up by FISA should not be used against Americans and that any search of this info collected without probable cause should only be used to spy on FOREIGNERS not AMERICANS!

The national debt just passed $39 trillion. My Six Penny Plan cuts six pennies out of every dollar Washington spends. Balanced budget in five years. If your family can live within its means, so can the federal government.

If the government wants to read your emails, it should have to convince a judge first. That's what the Fourth Amendment requires. That's what my Fourth Amendment Restoration and Protection Act restores. No warrant, no search.

Free trade is simple: both parties walk away better off.

That's what made America great. Limited government, low taxes, balanced budgets, and leaving people alone to make their own decisions.

Video

Washington is trying to ban hemp, a winning cash crop for Kentucky farmers.

I'm working with Sen. Klobuchar on a bill that lets states set their own hemp rules. Call your senator and tell them to support it: (202) 224-3121.
